title: PiglinGirls
description: Add a female model to the 3 piglin variants
body:
This resource pack replaces the default Piglin, Piglin Brute, and Zombified Piglin with custom female-style versions while preserving their iconic Nether appearance and personality. Featuring redesigned 3D models, updated textures, and unique details for each variant, it blends naturally into Minecraft's vanilla aesthetic.
